games.pitch: A bullet-heaven roguelite in what's left of New London. Take a contract from one of four warring factions, deploy as one of ten classes, and build a gun out of whatever the level-ups hand you before the city closes in.
games.title: DET-33

games.pitch: A roguelike down through a research base gone wrong. Eight classes, a bag that holds three things, and four captain keys to find before you can leave.
games.title: Kepler452b

games.pitch: A neon shooter on a pachinko board. Every invader you break drops a ball through the pins. Cash out between waves, or let it ride.
games.title: Pachinko Descent

games.pitch: Crystal armies on a 5x5 war table. Every unit strikes once as it lands, friend or foe, so aim carefully.
games.title: Bulwark

games.pitch: Glazed tiles and gold notches. Match a notch exactly and the tile fires its own, which can cascade across the whole board.
games.title: Coterie
